what: check render: these train_v1 scene indices re-rendered with work2 and the train_v2 floor block, compared with the same scenes' train_v1 renders (frozen below) and the real DEV ranges; v2_check.py evaluates it
scenes_from: configs/train_v1.json (data_train); scene i of train_v2 has the same definition except the floor
selection: train_v1 train/val scenes with >= 8 empty holes, >= 3 uncapped vials and >= 2 empty top-row holes, sorted by exposure, 6 evenly spaced

rules.U3: uncapped lit-floor (hole_Lp90) median > empty hole_Lp90 90th percentile

real_dev_report_only.empty_all_p10_p90: core L* 13-33, lit floor 41-65 (misread holes), b* 13-18

uncapped.source: 12 views of 2 vials (run 1 G07, run 2 G03)

calibration.knobs: floor val_scale range x f and blue_scale only
calibration.f: min(Y(53) / Y(measured empty lit-floor L* median), Y(32) / Y(measured empty core L* median)), Y(L) = ((L + 16) / 116)^3, limited to 0.25-4: the lit floor (E2, the probe's cue) drives the value, the core L* (E1) only caps it; E1's range already holds train_v1's dark holes
calibration.blue: x0.85 if empty b* median < 13, x1.15 if > 18

measures: v2_analysis.features on raw crops (positions.PositionMap offset 0), as for the real DEV numbers
